method: Six-turn schedule metrics at every boss phase and threats 0/4.
45s pressure fixtures: no weapons, explicit invulnerability and low boss HP to hold final phase; measures traffic, not survival.

72 practice battles: 6 bosses × 6 presets × tiers II/IV, threat 0, power 18, 10Hz visible-state reactive pilot; Q heals when ready and at least 6 HP are missing (same policy for both builds). No HP, invulnerability or damage changes in practice battles.
Pre-equipped legal training fixtures; does not test shop acquisition or establish human win rates.
